author: Vinheteiro
description:
in this video, I show the origin of music, with iconic and typical songs of every country: Austria (Ballad, Oh Du lieber Augustin), Germany (O Tannenbaum, Du, du liegst mir im Herzen), England (Greensleeves, Broadside Ballads, March of the Grenadiers), Scotland (Scotland the Brave), Ireland (Sailor’s Hornpipe, Irish Washerwoman), Spain (Pasodoble, Gran Vals), Italy (Tarantella Napoletana, Funiculì, Funiculà), Portugal (Fado, O Vira), Poland (Mazurka, Clarinet Polka, Lipka), Ukraine (Hey, Sokoly!), Russia (Russian Romance, Kalinka, Korobeiniki, Katyusha), Finland (Ievan Polkka), USA (Ragtime), Argentina (El Choclo, Por Una Cabeza), Brazil (Choro), Mexico (Cielito Lindo, La Cucaracha), Peru (El Cóndor Pasa), Cuba (Salsa), Israel (Folk), Japan (Folk Song).
I hope you enjoy.
